title: Pure Inzektor
summary: Inzektor cards with generic staples. The page's combo lines add Galaxy-Eyes and Snake-Eyes cards, so they use cards this list leaves out. Dragonfly and Centipede equip other Inzektors to themselves and pay you back every time an equip is sent to the GY; Hornet blows itself up to destroy a card, and Zektrike Kou-ou, the newest card, pulls any Inzektor from the Deck.
main: Inzektor Dragonfly
Equips an Inzektor from the hand or GY; when an equip on it goes to the GY, summons an Inzektor from the Deck.
Inzektor Centipede
Equips an Inzektor from the hand or GY; when an equip on it goes to the GY, searches an Inzektor card.
Inzektor Hornet
Equipped: sends itself to the GY to destroy a card.
Inzektor Ladybug
Equipped: sends itself to the GY to raise a monster's Level.
Inzektor Giga-Mantis
Equips from the hand for 2400 ATK; sent to the GY, revives another Inzektor.
Inzektor Giga-Weevil
Equips from the hand for 2600 DEF; sent to the GY, revives an Inzektor.
Inzektor Giga-Cricket
Equips itself from the GY by banishing an Insect.
Inzektor Ant
Equipped: adds its stats, and takes destruction in place of its holder.
Inzektor Firefly
Level 1 host: looks at the opponent's Set cards when an Inzektor equips to it.
Inzektor Hopper
Equipped: sends itself to the GY to let its holder attack directly.
Inzektor Earwig
Equipped: adds its stats, and 1000 ATK when it leaves for the GY.
Zektrike Kou-ou
Newest support. Sends an Inzektor card to the GY to summon or equip any Inzektor from the Deck, or equip an Inzektor Equip Spell.
Inzektor Sword - Zektkaliber
Equip Spell: +800; leaving the field, returns an Inzektor from the GY to the hand.
Inzektor Crossbow - Zektarrow
Equip Spell: the opponent can't respond to the equipped Inzektor's effects.
Inzektor Orb
Equip Trap that sends itself to negate an effect targeting your Inzektor.
extra: Link-2 for Insects: equips an Insect from the Deck, and recycles three Insects to draw.
Rank 6: equips a monster from either GY and sends a card from each side.
Rank 5 for Insects: steals an opposing monster or one from their GY as an equip.
Generic Insect Rank 3: negates a monster effect on the field and revives an Insect.
